_provenance.notes: First golden baseline. All values verified against hand calculations and integration tests in test_chain_extended.py.

signal_e.provenance: hand calculation: integral of QE * L_post_optics * A_collect * Omega_pixel * (lambda/hc) dlambda * t_int; cross-checked against test_chain_extended.py::test_photoelectrons_positive

e_rate_per_s.provenance: hand calculation: signal_e / t_int = 105771.65 / 0.005; verified via stage_outputs

A_collect.provenance: hand calculation: pi/4 * 0.30^2 = 0.070686 m^2; verified in test_chain_extended.py::test_A_collect

Omega_pixel.provenance: hand calculation: (18e-6)^2 / 1.20^2 = 2.25e-10 sr; verified in test_chain_extended.py::test_Omega_pixel

noise_shot.provenance: hand calculation: sqrt(signal_e) = sqrt(105771.65) = 325.226; Poisson statistics; verified in test_chain_extended.py::test_shot_noise_formula

noise_dark_shot.provenance: hand calculation: sqrt(dark_rate * t_int) = sqrt(100 * 0.005) = sqrt(0.5) = 0.7071; verified in test_chain_extended.py::test_dark_shot_noise

noise_read.provenance: direct parameter: readout.read_noise_e_rms = 5.0; verified in test_chain_extended.py::test_read_noise

noise_quantization.provenance: hand calculation: gain / sqrt(12) = 1.0 / sqrt(12) = 0.28868; verified in test_chain_extended.py::test_quantization_noise

noise_rss.provenance: hand calculation: sqrt(shot^2 + dark_shot^2 + read^2 + quant^2); RSS of all noise terms

snr.provenance: hand calculation: signal_e / noise_rss = 105771.65 / 325.265 = 325.19; verified in test_chain_extended.py::test_snr_formula
